headline: Century Extrusions announces rights issue review for investors
hook: SME rights issue open for review
summary: Century Extrusions has announced a rights issue for 2026, with analysts suggesting well-informed investors may park moderate funds for the long term. Rights issues allow existing shareholders to buy additional shares at a discount to the market price. Retail investors should evaluate their current holdings and subscription costs before participating. The review provides guidance on capital allocation for long-term holders of the company's stock.
why_it_matters: Existing shareholders must decide whether to subscribe or dilute holding.
